# Frozen Work execution protocol

## Authorization and preserved preparation

The maintainer's September 21 instruction authorizes 12 fresh native Work
sessions and durable PR publication after every completed test. This protocol
supersedes only the clean preparation's strict executor-isolation requirement,
unselected runtime settings and execution date; it does not revise task texts,
five criteria per task, serious-error definitions, comparisons or benefit gates.
The original preparation JSON SHA-256 is
`f915dc52d0bd7c296dec3e676f68885c0bc320c7a38cc1bb8c5082ef842c0c36`.
Its original archive remains inside the input freeze. This is a new study;
neither original failed workers nor prior answers are reused or repaired.

## Conditions and source

| Arm | Original AGENTS text | Native RI aid |
|---|---|---|
| NONE | Unavailable | Unavailable |
| AGENTS | Complete root and applicable nested guidance | Unavailable |
| RI | Unavailable | Supplied native verification and complete task-context stdout; further native operations available |
| AGENTS_RI | Complete root and applicable nested guidance | Same RI treatment |

All arms share ordinary source documents, including README, CONTRIBUTING,
glossary, doctrine and RI architecture documentation. This is not removal of
all navigation or all knowledge about RI. Native RI retains structural
AGENTS metadata; it does not supply the original instruction-document text.
The primary comparison is AGENTS_RI against AGENTS; RI against NONE and the
two AGENTS contrasts are secondary and cannot rescue a failed primary gate.

Source: `989fc1398fc221ffca4e1f7a141b2c03bfc7cfb3`, preserved as an unchanged
388-file Git archive. No live PR state or external sources are supplied.
Before dispatch, run the accepted producer's `verify` and `context-for-task`
with each exact Ukrainian task. Both RI arms receive identical complete stdout
for that task, including empty or weak lexical matches. No translated query,
custom ranking, shortened inventory or extra interpretation is inserted.
Additional native operations use the same unchanged producer and projection.

## Execution and access

Exactly 12 original slots, WF01-WF12, mapped in the frozen sessions file to
the prepared CF-01 through CF-12 order. One fresh `fork_turns=none` conversation
per slot, no model or reasoning override, same inherited configured model.
The exact serving backend and any hidden platform input remain unverified.
The coordinator does not provide earlier conversation, answers or scoring keys.

The shared reader checks permissions on read, list and search, rejects path
escape/symlinks, and limits exposure to the pinned manifest. All conditions
exclude the producer's direct source and benchmark corpus; controls exclude
generated RI, and no-guide arms exclude every AGENTS file. No generated site
is included in the archive. Original instruction routes requiring unavailable
aids do not override the authorized fixture condition.

Other tools remain technically available. Participants are explicitly told
not to use direct filesystem/network/connectors/personal memory or other agents.
These are instructional restrictions, not OS isolation. Reader logs attest
only traffic through that reader, not absence of off-reader access. Record
observed or reported deviations; a known exposure breach or materially
incomplete required read invalidates the affected comparison. Mere technical
availability does not itself count as observed contamination. No claim of
verified platform-wide isolation will be made even when logs look compliant.

Budget: 90 reader operations, including start pages, errors and rereads;
10,000 Unicode-character pages; 450-650 Ukrainian-word answer target.
Tool calls request enough output capacity to preserve complete pages.
Participants must fully read their initial message, all invoked RI responses,
required AGENTS and task-critical sources they rely on. Starting messages
are delivered by the logged start operation and must be completely paged.
No hints, repairs, model substitution, criterion changes or selective reruns.
The first answer is written once; refusals/interruption remain outcomes.

## Durable checkpointing

Publish the immutable input archive before the first scored session. Record
every dispatch and native task identity locally. After each first answer or
failure, publish that slot's answer, journal, RI stdout cache, measured record
and updated ledger to the PR branch, then read back the branch commit/tree.
Only after that acknowledgment may a replacement queue slot be dispatched.
At most three tested slots run concurrently. A publication failure stops new
dispatches while preserving active workers' outputs. Progress commits remain
Draft evidence; they are not an adoption, CI success or readiness claim.

## Scoring and fixed decisions

After collection, a fresh separate assessor receives exact task text, unchanged
criteria/serious errors, ordinary source evidence and shuffled verbatim answers
under opaque IDs. It receives no arms, read logs, costs or dispatch order.
Participants are asked to omit tool/condition narration from substantive answers;
their answers are never rewritten to improve blinding. Any residual identifying
content or assessor uncertainty is disclosed. First completed scores are hashed
before mapping. Agent assessment is not independent human replication.

Score 0: materially incorrect or any serious error. Score 1: at least one
substantive criterion unmet. Score 2: all five criteria met with owning evidence
and no serious error. Report each criterion and concrete corrections, not
understanding percentages or invented counts of human interventions.

Primary gate requires all three pairs valid and no treatment quality loss or
new serious error. Quality signal: at least two treatment improvements reaching
2. Alternative efficiency signal: every answer in both primary arms scores 2,
aggregate treatment source/RI operations <= 0.80 of control and aggregate
recorded initial-plus-tool-response UTF-8 bytes <= control. Report per-task
burdens too. No significance/equivalence claim follows from three tasks and
one realization per cell. Stop after this series regardless of outcome.

Measured input is exact native-bootstrap bytes plus every rendered reader
response, including full initial-message pages, wrappers, errors and rereads.
Initial-message bytes are not charged twice; archived stdout copies are not
extra model context. Operations include start delivery, source access and
native queries/pagination; report categories separately. Source/RI operation
efficiency excludes start-message delivery operations while their bytes remain
fully counted. Actual model tokens, hidden framing, context reprocessing,
wall-clock latency and money are unavailable. Preparation is separate overhead.

Any signal supports only a proposed limited workflow trial, subject to a
separate maintainer decision. No mandatory RI guidance changes or full RI-EVAL
acceptance are authorized by the act of running this study.
